facts.fact: Jack 来叫 Adam 出发：他们已经找到了 Archive，只要 Adam 准备好就可以动身。
facts.anchor: “We did.” Jack grinned. “We’re ready to go if you are.”

facts.fact: Adam 从床底下小心地挖出 Binder 家族的 grimoire 带上。
facts.anchor: He gently dug the Binder family grimoire out from under the bed.

facts.fact: 腕表被设计用来把佩戴者的 aura 同步到学校，使他们无论走得多远都不会丢失时间。
facts.anchor: “It’s designed to sync your aura to the school so that you won’t lose time no matter how far afield we go.”

facts.fact: 腕表的研发分工：Hex 与 Professor Lawless 完成了大部分工作，Daff 自己只研究了来自学校时间中心的时序漂移。
facts.anchor: “Hex and Professor Lawless did most of the work. I just researched the chronological drift from the school’s temporal center.”

facts.fact: Daff 提醒：旅途中绝不能吃喝任何东西——这个问题他们还没能解决。
facts.anchor: Just don’t eat or drink anything. We still haven’t solved that problem.

facts.fact: Hex 正在尝试计算逆转共振变化的方法——据 Daff 说，一旦成功，他们就有办法把 Lost Ones 送回原来所在的时间与地点。
facts.anchor: “She’s trying to calculate a way to reverse the change in resonance.

facts.fact: Vran 并未真正消失：他与学校之心融合了，这意味着他会在其他世界活一千（a thousand）种别的生命，只是不在他们的世界。
facts.anchor: He’d merged with the school’s heart, which meant he’d live a thousand other lives in other worlds, just not theirs.

facts.fact: Adam 问是否需要额外人手防身；Jack 指着 Daff 说他带来了一个 “ringer”（顶替选手）。
facts.anchor: “We have it.” Jack nodded to Daff. “I’m bringing a ringer.”
